title: PRF versus xenograft in sinus augmentation in case of HA -coating implant placement: A 36-month retrospective study
authors: Dominiak S, Karuga -Kuźniewska E, Popecki P, Kubasiewicz -Ross P. Adv Clin Exp Med. 2021 Jun;30(6):633-640. doi: 10.17219/acem/134202.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “After 3 years of follow -up, the results of sinus lifting solely using PRF with simultaneous implantation were promising, especially in terms of soft tissue management. Therefore, PRF can be regarded as an alternative to previously used materials” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
